# EZ-Tree generated mobile conifers

`pine_realistic_a.glb` and `pine_realistic_b.glb` are original deterministic
geometry exports generated with [EZ-Tree 1.1.0](https://github.com/dgreenheck/ez-tree)
by Daniel Greenheck (MIT License), using its `Pine Medium` preset with seeds
13977 and 8345. They use a mobile detail pass (roughly 5,812 triangles per
variant): 2x longitudinal section stride, 0.72 radial segment factor, every
second foliage card retained, 1.38 card scaling, and single-card foliage.

The game applies its existing CC0 Quaternius foliage/bark textures and Godot
materials at runtime rather than embedding upstream textures in these files.
Generated geometry may be used and modified under the included MIT license.
